summary: Concurrent ICMP rate-limit checks race on the global token-bucket fields before the function takes the bucket spinlock.

call_chain.evidence: KCSAN read stack and EXPORT_SYMBOL(icmp_global_allow) identify this shared ICMP limiter entry.
KCSAN write stack reaches the same exported rate limiter from an independent packet transmit context.

interleaving: CPU0 reads icmp_global.credit or icmp_global.stamp before acquiring icmp_global.lock.
CPU1 acquires the lock, refills the token bucket, and writes icmp_global.stamp/credit.
The unannotated lockless read races with the protected write; the fix pairs READ_ONCE with WRITE_ONCE.

ground_truth_access.required_ordering: The lockless fast path must use single-copy atomic marked reads that are paired with the later marked writes under icmp_global.lock.

vulnerability_surface.why_relevant: The race is possible because the global ICMP token-bucket fields are shared by all ICMP senders and are read before taking the bucket lock while later being written under that lock.

aliases.name: icmp_global.credit
aliases.evidence: Global anonymous struct field read at the fast-path empty-bucket check and written after token accounting.

aliases.name: icmp_global.stamp
aliases.evidence: Global timestamp field read in delta calculation and written when refill increments are applied.

thread_a.evidence: icmp_global_allow directly dereferences the static global fields.

thread_b.evidence: The same function updates the static global fields after acquiring icmp_global.lock.

published_by: EXPORT_SYMBOL(icmp_global_allow) exposes users of the limiter

coverage.analysis_conclusion: The patched and reported accesses are both inside the exported ICMP global limiter; caller files explain one observed stack but are not needed to represent the shared object access.

patch_hunks: bbab7ef23503 adds READ_ONCE to icmp_global.credit/stamp reads and WRITE_ONCE to icmp_global.stamp/credit writes in icmp_global_allow().
indirect_edges: icmp_global_allow is exported with EXPORT_SYMBOL; KCSAN reports IPv6 ICMP send paths as observed callers.
